Life, the breath of a person.

The fruit of the Spirit.

The whole building, fitted together.

The gospel that was preached by me.

In the world you have trouble.
Tribulation produces perseverance.

No one who wants to be known openly acts in secret.

Let us then with confidence draw near to the throne of grace.

To be strengthened with power through his Spirit.

The light of the knowledge of the glory of God.
He is the radiance of God's glory.

The twelve, and later others such as Paul.

Numbered with the eleven apostles.
Then to all the apostles.

In Antioch there were prophets and teachers.
A great prophet has arisen among us.

elsewhere.note: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ.
That you may walk worthily of the Lord.
To walk worthily of God.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: Bearing with one another, and forgiving each other.
Being persecuted, we endure.
I wish that you would bear with me.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: The very thing which I was also zealous to do.
Give diligence to present yourself approved to God.
Be more diligent to make your calling and election sure.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: The whole body, nourished and knit together through the joints and ligaments.
Love, which is the bond of perfection.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

No one has ascended into heaven.
I am ascending to my Father.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: If anyone is destined for captivity, to captivity he goes.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

Do the work of an evangelist.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.
Third teachers.
Not many of you should be teachers.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: For the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: Jesus increased in wisdom and stature.
Which of you by being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?
He is of age.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

range.note: Be thrown about like a boat.

elsewhere.note: Tossed back and forth by waves.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: He rebuked the winds and the sea.
A reed shaken by the wind?
Driven by fierce winds.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

elsewhere.note: He who teaches, in his teaching.
Give heed to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.
The things which fit sound doctrine.

He catches the wise in their craftiness.
Not walking in craftiness.

The due penalty of their error.
The spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

Speaking great swelling words of emptiness.

A partial hardening has happened to Israel.

Purge out the old yeast.
